_note: FROZEN 2026-11-19, written BEFORE the quote-on-page check existed. Each case is a piece of an answer and the verdicts the check must give, one per quotation it checks, in order. A quotation is checked only when the same sentence carries a document citation of the form [Doc N, p. M] / [Doc N, pp. M-K] / [Doc N, page M] / [Doc N, para M]. Verdicts: ok (on the cited page or paragraph), other_page (in the same document, elsewhere: found_on given), other_doc (only in another document), not_in_file (nowhere in the documents given), unknown_doc (the answer cites a document number that was not given), skipped_short (under five words). The check proves WHERE words are, never that the answer's use of them is right (case 17). Written by Claude.
